card.name: Linking words before DPP-4 inhibitor names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as different, other, and, using, taking or with, placed just before a named drug or drug class (usually a DPP-4 inhibitor, metformin or pioglitazone) in warnings about type 2 diabetes drugs.

modes.label: Different or other drug
modes.description: Words like different or other that point to another member of the same drug class.
modes.example: restarting the same drug or a<< different>> DPP-4 inhibitor.

modes.label: Use with a named drug
modes.description: Linking words or verbs such as and, using, taking or with that lead into a drug name.
modes.example: twice daily<< and>> metformin results in increased plasma levels
